slides.headline: Trump says Florida rallies are coming for Donalds
slides.body: Trump announced Florida rallies to boost Byron Donalds after recent reporting drew his anger.

slides.headline: That puts Trump inside the governor’s race
slides.body: Donalds is the Republican nominee for Florida governor in 2026 and will face Democratic nominee David Jolly.

slides.headline: The reason: Trump mentions disappeared online
slides.body: Trump mentions disappeared from Donalds’ campaign website, and most were removed with 6 weeks to go.

slides.headline: And Donalds says Trump’s agenda is common sense
slides.body: Donalds called Trump’s agenda “common sense” after some Trump mentions were removed from his campaign website.
